title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2002, Dragon Ball Z: Budokai became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2002, Dragon Ball Z: Budokai became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the fighting category, Dragon Ball Z: Budokai broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
